epistemic_guardrails: These later vintages are preserved separately from the April/October contemporaneous Judgments; they must never rewrite earlier expectations with hindsight.
Samsung Q3 2023 supports a scoped PC/mobile demand-improvement and customer-inventory-adjustment-completion observation, not a claim that every memory end-market recovered.

SK hynix July 2023 says the company decided to further reduce NAND production because NAND inventory was higher than DRAM; this is a management decision/commitment and is not by itself proof that the additional reduction had already been executed.
The earlier SK hynix >50% magnitude applies only to consolidated 2023 investment and must not be attached to NAND production, wafer starts or bit supply.
Grounding creates EvidenceFragments only; Reality/Judgment revision and Outcome comparability remain separate promotion decisions.
